# Introduction

Cultists are aggressive creatures found in Mountains inside Frost Caves. Their appearance is distinctly werewolf-like, however, unlike Fenrings and Ulvs, they wear tattered red hooded cloaks.

### Drops

• Item: Cultist trophy | 0 Star: 10%

• Item: Red jute | 0 Star: 1-2

### Spawning

• Type: Rare spawn point in Frost Caves. | Limit: - | Frequency: One time | Stars: No

### Fireclaw double

The exact same as Fireclaw[1], but swings a second time with its other hand and has a 10-second cooldown (35 Slash 40 Fire damage each hit).

### Fireclaw

Swings its claw in a 90-degree horizontal arc that is 3 meters long to scratch the player, which applies the Burning status (35 Slash 40 Fire damage). This attack has a 2-second cooldown and can be used within 1.5 meters of the player.

### Flames

Brings both arms down before sending out a blast of fire which applies the Burning status (50 Fire damage). It hits in a 4-meter 35-degree horizontal arc and can hit through walls. This attack cannot be blocked, has a cooldown of 10 seconds, and can be used 2–6 meters from a player; it cannot be used if the player stands close.
